members.name: phd
doc: Drives the small "PhD" badge, for a non-medical employee on the manual list (employees/honorific.ts).

members.name: discipline
doc: Set when a doctor's discipline (Medicine, ENT ...) is known; it feeds the chip beside EXE and the Discipline column (hospital/discipline.ts).

members.name: isDoctor
doc: Marks a doctor: the medical track, or flagged in the roster (a doctor whose designation is a managerial one).

members.name: departmentCode
doc: I set these only when the person asked for them (e.g. "... with department codes"): the codes of the department / designation.

members.name: extraFields
doc: Any other column the answer returned (rank, seniority position, "has NIC email" ...); I show it as small labelled chips on the card.

symbols.name: searchEmployeesByName
symbols.sig: export async function searchEmployeesByName( ds: DataSource, raw: string,): Promise<EmployeeResult[]>
doc: - literal trigram similarity + ILIKE (typo / partial tolerance)
- phonetic dmetaphone match, but ONLY on COMPLETE words (a word is "complete" if it is followed by a space or another word; the trailing partial word stays literal-only).
My ranking: exact whole-name > starts-with > high trigram > phonetic.

symbols.name: searchEmployeesByNameInDept
symbols.sig: export async function searchEmployeesByNameInDept( ds: DataSource, fragment: string, sailDeptIds: number[], limit = 50,): Promise<EmployeeResult[]>
doc: NAME FRAGMENT + DEPARTMENT search (on Enter). You remember part of a name and the department, e.g. "soumit c&it" or "roy blast furnace" (any word order). I filter the department EXACTLY by `sail_department` ids (Stage 8 overhaul, 28 Sep 2026 -- was legacy `departments.code`, see sailDepartments.ts); I match the name fragment forgivingly (partial ILIKE OR phonetic).

FIXED (28 Sep 2026): this used to sort by parsed ticket number, with a doc comment literally claiming that was "seniority-ordered" -- it wasn't. Now it joins `employee_roster` and sorts strictly by `global_seniority_rank`, the same no-exceptions rule every other people-list in the app now follows. I use a LEFT JOIN so the 3 roster rows with no `user_id` link still sort correctly relative to everyone else (they just won't have live contact fields).
